cases.scenario: A numeric batch size is validated before decimal arithmetic

files.bin/batch-window.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if (( $# != 1 )); then exit 2; fi
value=$1
if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'decimal batch size required' >&2
    exit 2
fi
size=$((10#$value))
if (( size < 1 || size > 200 )); then exit 2; fi
